Line length by conductor

Service cable by size

Line length is the sum of the spans between your poles, walked in order. Service cable is the sum of every customer drop. Both come from the GPS coordinates, so nothing is typed and nothing is left empty.

Transformer surveying summary

Counted from what you have collected so far. Service cable totals use the real length. This is the take-off, so you can check quantities before leaving the zone.
